Overview of Thurgau Region (Thurgau)

Thurgau Region (Thurgau) is located in the Thurgau region of Switzerland, with its prefectural capital at Frauenfeld. Key sights and travel highlights across the prefecture include Historic Altstadt / Old Town, Panoramic mountain & lake views, Marked SwitzerlandMobility hiking trails, Local heritage museum.

RegionThurgau
Capital cityFrauenfeld
Cities & municipalities22
Primary transport hubFrauenfeld Central Station (SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways)

How to get to Thurgau Region

Connected via hourly SBB CFF FFS rail and PostBus services; fully covered by the Swiss Travel Pass. Use our SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways Fare & Route Calculator and Rail Pass Value Helper to compare rail tickets and regional passes.

Signature local food in Thurgau

When visiting cities across Thurgau, look out for these regional specialties at station restaurants, markets, and local izakaya:

  • Cheese fondue
  • Raclette
  • Rösti
  • Bircher muesli
  • Swiss artisanal chocolate

Best time to visit Thurgau

Best time to visit Thurgau: Jun–Sep (summer trails), Dec–Mar (winter sports).
